subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming + tools)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, devteam@acme.com
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP kickoff + integration details

Hi Alice / Acme team,

Thanks for taking the time today — good conversation and clear alignment on the priority integration milestones. Per our call, I wanted to capture the immediate next steps and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the integration build plan. I attached a draft MAP PDF and a simple owners spreadsheet for quicker edits.

Quick recap / asks:
- Goal: Production-ready SDK integration with streaming + tool-calling & structured outputs for Acme's support assistant.
- Target close: we discussed end of Q1; open to locking a date once engineering scope is validated.

Milestones (first pass):
1) SDK integration (basic requests + auth) — Owner: Acme Eng (Tom) / Redwood SDK team (Marissa) — Dep: API key exchange, sample app
2) Streaming responses + reconnect logic — Owner: Redwood runtime (Rafael) / Acme Eng (Tom) — Dep: load test plan, network topology
3) Tool calling (calendar + search) — Owner: Acme PM (Alice) / Redwood integrations (Stephanie) — Dep: tool API contracts, auth scopes
4) Structured outputs (JSON schema) — Owner: Acme Eng (Tom) / Redwood ML (Marissa) — Dep: schema review, eval prompts
5) E2E QA & performance sign-off — Owner: Acme QA / Redwood SRE (Rafael) — Dep: test harness, SLAs

Please review the attached MAP draft and owners sheet. If you can confirm owners for each milestone and the target close date (we discussed March 31 as a preliminary target), I will update the MAP and circulate a version for sign-off.

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (draft), integration_owners_sheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Subject: MAP v1 (integration build plan) — draft with owners

Alice / Tom / Dev team,

Attached is MAP v1 (ACME-Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf) plus an owners sheet for quick edits (integration_owners_sheet.xlsx). I incorporated the owners you flagged and added proposed internal contacts for each milestone. Highlights below (please reply with changes inline):

Milestone detail + owners (current):
- SDK integration (auth + basic calls): Acme: Tom Brooks; Redwood: Marissa Cole (SDK lead)
- Streaming + reconnect: Acme: devteam@acme.com (network); Redwood: Rafael Mendes (runtime/SRE) — Redwood to provide streaming guide
- Tool calling (calendar, search): Acme: Alice Chen (PM) / Tom Brooks (eng); Redwood: Stephanie Nguyen (integrations) — need tool API contracts
- Structured outputs (JSON schema): Acme: Tom Brooks; Redwood: Marissa Cole / Applied ML reviewer (to be assigned)
- E2E QA & perf: Acme QA; Redwood: Rafael Mendes

Key dependencies we flagged:
- API key exchange / KMS agreements (security review)
- Network/egress topology for streaming and reconnects
- Tool API scopes and OAuth flow for tool-calling
- A small eval prompt set for structured outputs and regression checks

Next steps (proposal):
1) Tom to provide scope & rough dev ETA by 2026-03-02.
2) Acme to confirm owners in the owners sheet (I can edit live).
3) Redwood to produce streaming guide and a short checklist for QA by 2026-03-04.
4) Reconcile MAP and schedule sign-off call week of 2026-03-08.

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf, integration_owners_sheet.xlsx

Marissa

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Thanks for the clear doc — a few operational notes from my side:
- Redwood will own the streaming guide + reconnect best practices. I'll assign an SRE and share the checklist by 2026-03-04.
- For performance sign-off, propose the following SLOs: p95 latency < 500ms for streaming tokens, error rate < 0.5% during load test. If Acme agrees, we'll include these in the MAP as target SLAs.
- On pricing: streaming + tool calls may impact units — I'll loop in finance on the HubSpot deal (link below) for an updated estimate; Rafael

Appreciate the updates — this looks solid. Tom will provide the scope by 2026-03-02 as discussed. We confirm the owners in the sheet (made a couple inline edits).

I'll expect the streaming guide by 3/4 and we'll plan to schedule the sign-off call for the week of 3/8.
